title: All about the Black Madonna
text: De Poblet was truly amazing - I enjoyed visiting all the buildings there very much, not only the church but also the areas where the monks lived.  The videos there were excellent.  My guide was fabulous, top-notch.  Montserrat was OK too, though I would have liked to visit the museum (as was said to be included in the Viator description).
author: Gina_A
